item.summary: fix(agents): compact mid-turn overflow while code-mode work is still pending (#129792) * fix(agents): compact mid-turn overflow while code-mode work is still pending #128970 let a mid-turn overflow compact and continue only when every lifecycle item was balanced. A code-mode exec that returns status "waiting" has its result persisted, but its nested tool keeps a lifecycle item active, so the gate failed closed: no compaction, a generic "couldn't generate a response" warning, and the waiting run expired before the operator could resume it. Continuation resumes from the persisted tool results and never replays the assistant call, so the transcript is the settlement proof: gate on every requested tool call having a recorded result. Nested code-mode work stays owned by the run registry and resumes through `wait`, exactly as across turns. * fix(agents): keep parked code-mode work fail-closed across a rotated compaction A parked code-mode run is bound to the session it started in and `wait` rejects any other session, so a compaction that adopts a successor session cannot redeem it.
